botcomponent.description: Use when the user asks about a SharePoint list item's changes, updates, or status and wants to be notified about it. Retrieves the item, then sends a Teams message, a calendar invite, and an HTML email about it in one pass. Do NOT use for requests unrelated to a SharePoint list item, or for reading document libraries, site pages, or performing a web search.
botcomponent.name: sharepoint-list-notification
